notes: v1.0.28 — LAUNCH-TIME FIXED (measured). Every launch was re-hashing ~1 GB of assets + all libraries with sha1, re-probing Java and the PowerShell hardware probe (5-min cache), re-fetching the Fabric meta API and writing every log line synchronously. Now all cached: hardware 0ms, assets 13ms (was ~1.5s+ of hashing), libraries 38ms, java cached 24h, Fabric short-circuits when installed, logs batched. Launcher-side prep before spawn is now ~50-100ms on a cached profile instead of many seconds. All safety systems intact; every stage logs real LAUNCH TIMING numbers.
